elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Rendered 21.1: "each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000" — symmetrical, and no residual unlimited-Customer-liability language remains.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Rendered 21.1 uses the exact greater-of construction: "Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000". "Fees" (cl. 1.5) is the recurring subscription/professional services/usage fee stream, so the base is not illusory.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Retained 21.2: "neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages, or for lost profits, revenues, or goodwill".

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3 defines Excluded Claims to include "a Party's breach of confidentiality... obligations", and the deletion of "without exception" plus the new "Except for Excluded Claims" opener in 21.1 places them outside the cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3 Excluded Claims expressly include "data-protection, or security obligations", now carved out of 21.1.
21.3 lists "its indemnification obligations" within Excluded Claims, excepted from the 21.1 cap.
21.3 Excluded Claims include "gross negligence"; 21.1 now opens "Except for Excluded Claims".

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3 Excluded Claims include "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property".

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Retained 21.3 covers only "undisputed Fees for conforming Services". "Fees" (cl. 1.5) expressly excludes taxes, reimbursable expenses, interest and any one-time implementation charge, and the "undisputed"/"conforming Services" qualifiers narrow it further, so this is a subset of Fees rather than Customer's payment obligations as a whole.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Rendered 21.1 caps "each Party's aggregate liability" on identical terms.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: Rendered 21.1: "Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim" — the prior one-month base is gone.
"Except for Excluded Claims" in 21.1 plus 21.3's inclusion of "its indemnification obligations".

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3 Excluded Claims include breach of confidentiality obligations, now genuinely outside the cap after deletion of "without exception".
21.3 Excluded Claims include "gross negligence", carved out of the 21.1 cap.
21.3 Excluded Claims include "wilful misconduct", carved out of the 21.1 cap.

reasons: Position-complete at the fallback level: the cap in 21.1 is mutual, re-based to twelve months' Fees, and the deletion of "without exception" restores the 21.3 Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct) as genuine super-cap items.

Preferred level fails on one element only. The Customer-payment carve-out in retained 21.3 reaches only "undisputed Fees for conforming Services", and defined "Fees" excludes taxes, reimbursable expenses, interest and the one-time implementation charge. To reach preferred, amend that sentence to read along the lines of: "Customer's obligations to pay amounts due under this Agreement, including Fees, taxes, expenses and interest, are not damages and are not subject to the limitation in Section 21.1."

Minimality holds: the edit is confined to the single cap sentence in 21.1 (basis, greater-of floor, and removal of the override phrase). No survival tails, procedures, damages categories or unrelated deletions were added, and the Customer-favourable direct-damages language in 21.2 and the whole of 21.3 are retained verbatim.

Intent preserved: the new "Except for Excluded Claims" opener in 21.1 mirrors the existing opener in 21.2, uses the already-defined term from 21.3, and leaves no dangling cross-reference or contradictory retained sentence (the conflicting "without exception" is the only wording removed).
Residual severity is low — the remaining gap is a preferred-level refinement of the payment carve-out, which the playbook treats as a rationale note rather than a standalone deviation.
